goal: Prevent incoming Tor connections from misclassifying and inheriting IP whitelist permissions
Stop automatic Tor service registration when explicit binds lack a dedicated onion listener
Ensure local listening sockets bind successfully before registering onion services with Tor
agreement: Strong support for preventing peer misclassification when explicit binds are configured
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD (winterrdog)
Approves handling container wildcard binds in separate work rather than adding options (vasild)
Startup failure objections resolved by disabling onion listening with a warning (sedited, mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents incoming Tor peers from inheriting unintended IP whitelist permissions
It eliminates peer misclassification when explicit binds lack a dedicated onion listener
It avoids registering onion services with the Tor daemon when local port binding fails
